title: 数据科学与机器学习学习笔记
summary: 该项目是作者完成Nodebook数据科学与机器学习课程后的学习笔记，包含使用Python、机器学习、深度学习及大语言模型的实际项目，并探索了生成式AI和AI代理，构建能思考、规划和行动的智能系统。
summary_en: This project is a collection of notebooks from the author's completion of the Nodebook Data Science & Machine Learning program, featuring real-world projects using Python, ML, DL, and LLMs, along with explorations in Generative AI and AI agents.
